does: Blends peeled garlic with salt and a little lemon juice to a paste, then pours in neutral oil very slowly, a thread at a time, alternating with more lemon juice, until the sauce turns white, thick and fluffy like a mayonnaise without egg.
how: Take the green germ out of the garlic cloves if they have one. It makes the sauce bitter.
Blend the garlic and salt to a fine paste, scraping down the sides.
With the machine running, pour in the oil in the thinnest thread.
Every so often stop the oil and add a spoonful of lemon juice, then go on with the oil.
Stop when the sauce is white and holds its shape. Keep it in the fridge in a closed jar.

cues.text: A white, fluffy sauce that holds a peak on a spoon.
Thick and light, like a mayonnaise.
Fierce raw garlic, salty and sharp.

mistakes.mistake: Pouring the oil too fast, so that the sauce splits into thin garlic oil.
mistakes.fix: Pour a thread at a time. To rescue a split sauce, start again with a fresh clove of garlic and add the split sauce slowly.

mistakes.mistake: Making it in a large blender jug with too little garlic, so that the blades cannot reach it.
mistakes.fix: Use a small bowl or a narrow jug, or make a bigger batch.

variant_of.differs: It is made with neutral oil and lemon juice in a blender, beaten to a white, fluffy sauce, not pounded with olive oil in a mortar.
